units.source_text: 女人颠来跑去的动静，无休止地继续着。

en.t: The sound of the woman rushing back and forth went on without end.

units.source_text: 大网篮好几次凑近，又走远了。

en.t: Several times the large rope basket came close, then moved away again.

units.source_text: 这样听下去，会妨碍明天工作的。

en.t: If he kept listening like this, it would interfere with his work tomorrow.

units.source_text: 本打算明天天一亮就起床，可以整整工作一天呢。

en.t: He had meant to get up at first light tomorrow and work for the whole day.

units.source_text: 谁知越想睡头脑反而越清醒。

en.t: But the more he tried to sleep, the more awake his mind became.

units.source_text: 眼睛开始阵阵刺痛起来。

en.t: His eyes began to sting in waves.

units.source_text: 眼泪、眨眼都无法抵挡不间断落下的沙子。

en.t: Neither tears nor blinking could hold off the sand that kept falling without pause.

units.source_text: 他掸了掸手巾，把脸包起来。

en.t: He shook out the towel and wrapped it around his face.

units.source_text: 呼吸不畅，但还是比沙子落得满脸要好。

en.t: It made breathing difficult, but it was still better than having sand fall all over his face.
